quick_skim.title: Dynamic geometry remapping of neural activity within frontal and subcortical areas during decision-making
quick_skim.abstract: Decision-making involves dynamic evaluation of competing options. Recording 16,495 neurons across nine frontal and subcortical areas in macaques revealed brain-wide fluctuations between encoding the attributes of available options. These dynamic representations track deliberation and scale with decision difficulty. Instead of binding attribute information of different options together, our analyses show that these representations are associated with dynamic area- and attribute-specific changes in neural geometry.
quick_skim.llm_evidence_en: Dynamic neural geometry in frontal cortex during decision-making reflects executive function processing.

quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 针对决策过程中选项属性表征如何在大脑区域间动态组织的问题，在猕猴九个额叶和皮层下脑区记录16495个神经元，发现神经元群在编码选项属性间动态波动，其几何表征随决策难度和过程变化，揭示了决策时额叶-皮层下环路采用动态几何重映射而非绑定属性的计算原理.
